title: A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.01801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PK

translated_title: 安全原型并非安全方向：响应安全嵌入中的参照依赖与提示混淆
translated_abstract: 响应的安全性是否可以通过与已知安全响应的平均嵌入之间的余弦相似度来评分？最近的一种潜伏代理检测器提出的正是这种评分方法，然而这种原始的正类质心规则并不具备可识别性：正样本观测值仅相对于编码器原点定位了安全类，但并未确定哪个方向能够真正区分安全与不安全的响应。我们在两个提示受控、人工标注的语料库和一个辅助的陪审团标注的源控制集上对该规则进行了审计，使用了四个冻结编码器和按提示分组的划分方式。在人工标注的语料库上，安全原型方法的ROC-AUC仅为0.457-0.545，其中两个单元格显著低于随机水平、一个高于随机水平，而显式的“安全减不安全”参照方法在同一嵌入上达到了0.588-0.738；在陪审团控制集上，原型方法甚至出现了反向结果（0.358-0.405），而参照方法达到了0.754-0.793。在验证校准的5%错误安全阈值下，参照方法在PK上接受了更多安全响应
tldr: 该论文揭示了用已知安全响应原型的余弦相似度来评分响应安全性并不可靠——这种质心规则依赖于编码器原点且受提示混淆影响，甚至在部分数据上出现反向，而显式的“安全减不安全”参照方向在同一嵌入上表现显著更优。
en_tdlr: Cosine similarity to a safe-response prototype is not a valid safety score due to reference dependence and prompt confounds—sometimes even inverting—while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference direction performs significantly better on the same embeddings.
